peerReviewScope: No current-turn peer review was read. Frozen predecessor artifacts, historical reviews, and adopted decisions were inspected only as lineage, finding-landing, and custody evidence.
verdictRule: ACCEPT only if no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX.

mustFix.title: Seven basedOn roles still assign live last-heading custody to D-344 after D-346.
mustFix.subjectPattern: Each listed role says Last-heading custody remains D-344.
mustFix.refutation: Live COORD's last heading is D-346 at HEAD 7dd4cc37239109c51a62b8c2dbd59a8c13d08537. The dispatch requires D-346, basedOn.d346.role claims last-heading custody, and basedOn.d344.role was updated to point to D-346. The seven present-tense D-344 custody assertions therefore contradict both live authority and the subject's purpose and findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody claims that basedOn.d346.role is the sole last-heading claimant.
mustFix.whyMustFix: Last-heading custody is load-bearing dispatch authority. A candidate cannot simultaneously claim D-346 as the sole live heading and preserve seven unqualified present-tense claims that custody remains at D-344.
mustFix.repairShape: In a frozen successor, remove the stale D-344 custody assertions or make the current custody consistently D-346 while preserving genuinely historical dispatch statements. Do not edit COORD or file 08.

mustFix.title: predecessorV7 and predecessorV4 falsely keep sarif leftover-join.v7 current after D-345 recorded v11.
mustFix.subjectPattern: Both roles say the current recorded DR-122 leftover remasurement is sarif leftover-join.v7 until a recordable successor is adopted.
mustFix.refutation: That condition has occurred. D-345 adopted sarif leftover-join.v11 as the DR-122 leftover remasurement, D-346 expressly leaves v11 as the D-345 current recorded remasurement, and the dispatch plus authorityClaim, purpose, and basedOn.predecessorV11.role all preserve v11 as current until another recordable successor is adopted.
mustFix.whyMustFix: The current-recorded pointer is frozen lineage custody. The two v7 assertions create two simultaneous current remasurements and directly contradict the adopted D-345/D-346 record.
mustFix.repairShape: In a frozen successor, describe v7 as the historical D-325 remasurement superseded by v11 at D-345, update the historical v4 role consistently, and preserve frozen v11 as current until a later recordable successor is adopted.

mustFix.title: The v8, v9, and v10 Stage A finding landings are rewritten from recorded v11 to candidate v12.
mustFix.subjectPattern: Each listed leaf says the frozen v8, v9, or v10 Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v12.
mustFix.refutation: D-345 already adopted v11 and expressly records the v8, v9, and v10 Stage A findings as landed at leftover-join.v11 of sarif. The frozen v11 subject carries those exact landings, and D-346 does not reopen or rewrite them. A v12 successor may carry the corrected content forward, but it cannot move the historical landing target from recorded v11 to an awaiting-review candidate.
mustFix.whyMustFix: Finding landing is frozen provenance, not a speaker token to be mechanically re-voiced on every successor. Redirecting already-landed findings erases the adopted D-345 custody boundary and makes an unrecorded candidate the claimed landing point.
mustFix.repairShape: In a frozen successor, preserve v11 as the landing target for all v8-v10 findings and separately state, if needed, that v12 carries those corrections forward. Do not edit v8, v9, v10, or v11.

mustFix.title: goldenOutfailV3 is still called current after D-346 recorded the v5 platform copies.
mustFix.subjectText: Current DR-122 leftover-design FC-OUTFAIL no-committed-run fixture implementations.
mustFix.refutation: D-346 calls sarif-fc-outfail-golden.v3 the historical D-297 first-authoring and records sarif-fc-outfail-golden.v5 as the four per-D-002-platform copies. The subject's own basedOn.goldenOutfailV5.role, OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX reason, authorityClaim, and proposedLaterWork agree that the four D-346 copies now exist and their authoring remainder is stale. The copied v3 role nevertheless retains its pre-D-346 current standing and omits the v5 copy custody.
mustFix.whyMustFix: This is a direct contradiction in the core FC-OUTFAIL provenance: the candidate cannot use D-346 to remove the copy-authoring remainder while keeping the D-297 first-authoring role labeled current as though the D-346 recording had not occurred.
mustFix.repairShape: In a frozen successor, identify v3 as the historical D-297 first-authoring source and v5 as the recorded D-346 platform-copy custody. Preserve v3 as the source implementation, keep FC-OUTFAIL.committed-run-preserved NOT-AUTHORED, and do not remasure or edit v5.

decision.reason: The frozen bytes, digests, required-now value, top-level leftover set, four D-346 copy digests, and non-authority boundaries verify. The candidate nevertheless carries four independent authority defects: seven stale D-344 last-heading custody claims, two stale assertions that v7 remains the current remasurement after D-345, a rewrite of the already-recorded v8-v10 finding landings from v11 to v12, and a pre-D-346 current label on the historical v3 first-authoring. With four MUST-FIX findings, the zero-finding acceptance rule requires REJECT.
decision.pathToAccept: Produce a frozen successor that makes D-346 the coherent live last-heading custody, preserves v11 as the D-345 current recorded remasurement, preserves v11 as the historical landing for v8-v10 findings while carrying their corrections forward, and marks goldenOutfailV3 historical while retaining v5 as D-346 platform-copy custody.
